description: Store.peek/4 (store.ex:187-200) limits the priority-ordered range to limit*10 BEFORE filtering by visibility. Reproduced: 100 priority-0 jobs scheduled at time 20000 plus one priority-100 job ready at time 10000 -> peek(limit: 10, now: 10000) returns []. Store.min_vesting_time/4 (535-550) likewise scans only the first 1000 rows: with 1000 future high-priority jobs plus a ready lower-priority job it reports 20000 instead of 10000. Manager can then reschedule the queue pointer too late. Provide complete ready-item discovery and a correct minimum-time query without an unbounded transaction. Test mixed priorities, delayed work, active leases, and queues above both bounds.
title: Prevent future jobs from hiding ready jobs behind scan limits
